2608.20047.title: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking
2608.20047.paper_summary: Watermarking schemes for large language model output are evaluated almost exclusively on English text using each scheme's detection threshold and a narrow set of quality measurements. Multilingual deployment exposes evaluation-design choices that are inconsequential on English but determine conclusions cross-lingually. We propose an evaluation framework with four components: detection thresholds calibrated empirically per deployment context, a threshold-independent companion measurement that distinguishes calibration failures from detection failures, three disjoint quality measurement paradigms (distributional, paired-semantic, and reference-perplexity), and a generalized-entropy decomposition of cross-language disparity over a typological family partition. Applied to six watermarking schemes, three open-weight generators, eleven languages spanning four scripts and eight typological families, and both base and instruction-tuned regimes, the framework reveals failure modes that single-language single-paradigm evaluation cannot surface. Across detection and quality, observed disparity is predominantly between-family on the typological partition, indicating that cross-lingual fairness gaps in watermarking are structural to language properties rather than idiosyncratic to particular languages.
2608.20047.paper_summary_zh: 水印方案對大型語言模型輸出的評估幾乎僅限於英語文本，使用每個方案的檢測閾值和狹窄的質量測量集。多語言部署揭示了評估設計選擇，這些選擇在英語中無關緊要，但卻決定了跨語言的結論。我們提出了一個包含四個組件的評估框架：根據每個部署上下文經驗校準的檢測閾值、一個與閾值無關的伴隨測量，用於區分校準失敗和檢測失敗、三種不相交的質量測量範式（分佈性、配對語義和參考困惑度），以及一個跨語言差異的廣義熵分解，基於一個類型學家族劃分。該框架應用於六種水印方案、三種開放權重生成器、涵蓋四種書寫系統和八種類型學家族的十一種語言，以及基礎和指令調整的兩種模式，揭示了單語言單範式評估無法顯現的失敗模式。在檢測和質量方面，觀察到的差異主要是在類型學劃分上的家族之間，這表明水印中的跨語言公平差距是結構性地與語言特性相關，而不是特定語言的特異性。
